# stb_truetype

`stb_truetype.h` v1.26 from https://github.com/nothings/stb at commit
f58f558c120e9b32c217290b80bad1a0729fbb2c (public domain / MIT, see the end of
the file). Used by the raylib backend to rasterize fonts with FreeType-like
em sizing (`src/Backend/Internal/RaylibFontAtlas.cpp`); raylib embeds its own
copy privately and does not expose it.
